sample_unit: paired panoramic radiograph and CBCT examinations (patients)

links.outcome: Proportion of examinations with completely error-free automated tooth numbering
links.effect: 148/171 (86.5%) panoramic and 155/171 (90.6%) CBCT examinations were error-free, so about 1 in 10 to 1 in 7 needed at least one manual correction, despite 99.29% per-tooth accuracy.
links.quote: At the case level, 148/171 (86.5%) panoramic radiographs and 155/171 (90.6%) cone-beam computed tomography examinations were error-free.

unlisted_practices: Reporting case-level error-free rate alongside tooth-position metrics for imaging AI

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic accuracy and case-level error rates of a commercial dental AI system retrospectively, without evaluating an implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
